102 Dalmatians - Puppies to the Rescue.name: Disney's 102 Dalmatians: Puppies to the Rescue
102 Dalmatians - Puppies to the Rescue.summary: Disney's 102 Dalmatians: Puppies to the Rescue is a platform game loosely based on the live-action Disney movie 102 Dalmatians. In Puppies to the Rescue you work your way through obstacles and mini games to save your siblings and parents from Cruella.

Mat Hoffman's Pro BMX.name: Mat Hoffman's Pro BMX
Mat Hoffman's Pro BMX.summary: Ride like 10-time World Vert Chamption Mat Hoffman or 7 other BMX pros. Pull off over 200 tricks and combo moves, including pro-signature moves. Shred through Street, Vert and Dirt courses with 4 different game modes to choose from.
